status: CONDITIONAL: actual Sep2025 anchor, FY25 and FY26 missing; not accepted
basis: Q3 2025 actual, estimated Q4 2025 and full 2026; separate estimated anchors, not historical observations. All GHS millions. No additional capital/deposits-for-shares assumed; current regulatory recognition unknown.

assumptions.capital_note: Sep25 reported CAR6.46% conditional on regulatory approval of deposits for shares; proxy capital anchored to assumed RWA density*assets*6.46%, downside excludes all pending shares, base 50% exclusion, upside none; no current regulatory return. Stated capital and deposit for shares remain as observed, no invented conversion.
assumptions.reserve_note: 50/25/12.5% of positive full annual PAT based on opening statutory reserve vs stated capital; FY25 statutory YTD movement zero, no dividends; actual FY25 losses/recoveries unobserved beyond September.
assumptions.funding_note: Funding base deposits plus borrowings; interest expense calibrated to Sep25 annualized over FY24/Sep25 average funding, no individual deposit/wholesale prices disclosed.
assumptions.yield_note: Blended earning pool net loans + securities + bank placements + 25% cash. 9M25 annualised yield calibrated to FY24/Sep25 average pool, rate beta on 364d bill; no contractual repricing data. Q4 fees/costs use actual 9M/3; Q4 impairment modeled as normalized cost, not extrapolated reversal. 2026 full year conditional, no observed Q3 data.
assumptions.fx: No future direct FX revaluation; historical cash flow FX separately disclosed. No new capital or OCI modeled. No dividends because retained deficit and capital uncertainty.

rate_reference.source: Shared build_macro.py; BoG S-BOG-SUM-JAN26 Jan–Sep 2025 interest-equivalent monthly series
rate_reference.method: Same-vintage simple nine-month mean; Q4 2025 flow run-rate unchanged; FY26–30 rate differences apply partial betas to calibrated yields.

assumptions.anchor_gap_note: FY25 estimated anchor gaps use forward FY26 screening thresholds only, not actual FY25 compliance (dynamic CRR unavailable).
assumptions.tax_note: 35% effective scenario rate, not statutory assertion; positive PBT only, no tax credit modeled; actual Q3 tax retained.
